Correction.description:
One graph-node status the takeover agent corrected, and why.

The record's answer to "what changed": a quiet reconciliation is evidence
of health only because a correcting one accounts for itself here.

evidence.description: What the repo shows that contradicts the prior status, as the agent gave it in the correcting tool call.
evidence.title: Evidence

node.description: The corrected node, as `<graph>/<node-id>` — the graph is the effort's own or a subgraph beneath it.
node.title: Node

Correction.title: Correction

NodeStatus.description:
A node's status is its session's status.

A node reaching `DONE` says nothing about a subgraph it may have spawned.
NodeStatus.title: NodeStatus

ReconciliationVerdict.description: What the takeover agent concluded about the effort's recorded state.
ReconciliationVerdict.title: ReconciliationVerdict

Telemetry.description: Read off the session's `result` event — the same event that means stale.
Telemetry.title: Telemetry

TicketCorrection.description:
One lying ticket `Status:` line the takeover agent corrected, and why.

The one write the harness ever makes to a tracker file (ADR-0010): the
line rewritten to an open status and a note appended, so a from-scratch
derivation cannot re-import the lie. Everything else in the ticket stays
what sessions wrote.

evidence.description: What the repo shows that contradicts the closed-out line, as the agent gave it in the correcting tool call.
evidence.title: Evidence

node.description: The node whose ticket was corrected, as `<graph>/<node-id>`.
node.title: Node

prior_status.description: What the lying line said, verbatim.
prior_status.title: Prior Status

TicketCorrection.title: TicketCorrection

ToolCall.description:
One harness-tool call, and whether it took effect.

A refused call is recorded rather than dropped: what the agent tried to do
and was not allowed to is the interesting half of a surprising decision.

refused.description: Why the tool layer refused it, or None when it took effect.
refused.title: Refused

ToolCall.title: ToolCall

description:
`reconciliations/<reconciliation-id>.json`.

One per takeover consultation. Written before the agent runs — so a slow
judgment is visible while it is being made — and rewritten once it ends.

corrections.description: Every graph-node status the consultation corrected, in the order the corrections landed. Empty for a clean effort.
corrections.title: Corrections

examined.description: One line per thing examined — every graph in the effort's subtree, gathered deterministically by the harness before the agent was consulted, never by the agent.
examined.title: Examined

model.description: The model the consultation ran on.
model.title: Model

prose.description: What the agent said. Recorded for the reader; it has no effect on any state.
prose.title: Prose

session_id.description: The ephemeral agent's own session id.
session_id.title: Session Id

ticket_corrections.description: Every ticket `Status:` line the consultation corrected, in the order the corrections landed. Empty for a clean effort.
ticket_corrections.title: Ticket Corrections

tool_calls.description: Everything the consultation actually did, refusals included.
tool_calls.title: Tool Calls

verdict.description: The verdict the agent landed as a tool call, or None when it landed none — in which case the takeover stopped instead of resuming.

title: ReconciliationRecord
